limits: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot together: at least 40%
Grenache and Syrah together: at least 40%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Syrah, Merlot, Grenache and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for red and rosé wine, made from grapes such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Grenache and Cabernet Franc. It became official only in 1999, making it one of the youngest in France.
